_comment: Public business identity used by the site (lib/site.ts). Leave a value empty ("") if it is not confirmed; optional sections are omitted automatically. Production builds (SITE_ENV=production) fail if any required value is empty. Never put secrets here. contact_email is a PLACEHOLDER until the domain and mailbox exist. exporter_positioning_approved: the site copy presents the company as the seller and exporter of the coffee; keep this false until the Ethiopian export licence is issued, operations are confirmed and the owner approves publication (see docs/exporter-positioning-review.md). Production builds fail while it is false.
whatsapp_message: Hello, I'm interested in buying Ethiopian coffee.
